axis: placid absence of worry → settled failure to care

members.tone: Leans on the not-caring half of the sense rather than the calm half, so the composure reads as something missing and carries a faint reproach that *unconcern* escapes.
Weights the calm, casual side instead — an untroubled evenness that may be only a seeming, and names the absent worry without *indifference*'s hint that nothing is felt at all.
